notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own logic (gb-maps-2). 64 team spawns in one room; the finish is the trigger that plays the end figure's `finish` animation (endguy, SetAnimation finish). Its 114 trigger_teleports aim at 45 destinations dest_1..dest_42: per-section pits, most behind `f_1` (the anti-standing filter: block triggers rename the player and these fire for that name), the rest unfiltered. Coins renamed `ng1`.. along the way are collectables, not stages. Not published.

zones.note: round `start`, where the spawn room sends you (2026-10-11): 64 team spawns stand in a holding room whose floor is a teleport to `start`, so a player is there a second after appearing. The start was the spawn room until then, and the importer had that floor send back to the spawn, which held every player in the room
